summary: Since Ansible 2.2 modules can be compiled binaries, which aren't made portable and may need runtime deps; they take args and return data like want JSON modules.
questions: Can I write an Ansible module in Go as a compiled binary?
How do binary modules receive arguments?
Are binary modules portable across systems?

answer_card.title: Binary modules
answer_card.answer_md: Since **2.2**, modules can be small binaries (e.g. Go). Ansible doesn't make them portable, so they may only work on systems like the one they were built on. Arguments and output work like want JSON modules (JSON file in, JSON on stdout).
